mechanisms.quote: List comprehensions with built-in functions have Python bytecode overhead. Built-in callables (`str`, `int`, `str.strip`, `str.lower`) are C implementations—passing them directly to `map()` avoids loop machinery.
mechanisms.other_description: Replaces Python-level list comprehensions with map()/filter() that call built-in C callables directly, avoiding per-element bytecode loop overhead. No existing id covers swapping comprehension loops for C-level map/filter calls.

mechanisms.quote: manually checking for empty strings before `filter(None, ...)` was redundant since `filter(None)` already removes them.
